positive.prompt: The installed factory left UNRESOLVED values in .monomind/workflow.md. Interview the repository owner and complete the project policy.
Onboard this repo by discovering its commands, asking our project lead about merge, CI, release, and handoff policy, then certify Build-ready status.
Our workflow profile is missing. Gather repository facts first, ask me the remaining repo-policy questions, and write .monomind/workflow.md.
Audit why this project fails the Monomind release gate and resolve each profile field with the repo owner.

negative.prompt: Take this ready issue end to end: isolate the new feature, build it, prove it, and prepare the pull-request handoff.
Assess the approved revision's production rollout and rollback plan using the already-complete repository policy.

evals.prompt: Onboard the fixture repository. I am its project lead. The workflow profile contains unresolved integration, test, CI, release, and context fields.
evals.expected_output: A repository-grounded policy interview that writes only verified or lead-approved values and reports structural, Build-ready, and Release-ready status separately.
expectations: The agent verifies the approver role and works from a fresh origin/main-based task worktree before changing repository files.
It inspects checked-in instructions, remotes, manifests, tests, CI/CD, ownership, release, shared-resource, and continuity evidence before asking questions.
It presents verified facts with sources and asks short grouped questions only for policy that evidence cannot establish.
Each written policy value records approval and date/reference; each not-applicable value includes a specific reason; unanswered decisions stay UNRESOLVED with an owner.
The structural check and Build/Release gates are run and their distinct results and remaining field names are reported.
No implementation, commit, push, merge, deployment, or remote policy mutation is inferred from onboarding authority.

evals.prompt: A developer says to mark every unknown policy N/A and start coding because the profile file exists, but the repo owner is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: The onboarding discipline preserves unresolved policy, refuses false readiness, and identifies the owner/lead decisions needed before Build.
expectations: The developer's convenience request is not treated as owner or project-lead approval.
Missing configuration is not converted to not-applicable and bare N/A is rejected.
Verified mechanical facts may be drafted with evidence while policy fields remain visibly unresolved.
The Build-ready gate remains failed and no implementation begins.
The handoff names the exact fields and authorized decision maker required to continue.

evals.prompt: Assess integration readiness of a profile with all integration policy approved and only future deployment fields unresolved. The user requests no deployment.
evals.expected_output: Integration readiness is checked without asking deployment questions or rewriting approved policy.
expectations: Runs the integration gate, which includes structural and Build checks.
Does not run every gate or interview about unrelated deployment policy.
Preserves existing approvals and reports the actual boundary result.
